implementationStatus: Implemented by agenthub-mcp over stdio, bound to one session at startup. The served inputSchemas are generated from the Go argument structs, so this file describes exactly what the tools accept: a field here that the server did not accept would be rejected as an additional property, which is worse than not offering it.
transport: stdio only. Streamable HTTP would put this surface on a socket, which is a separate decision from the peer listener and has not been taken.
privacy: A remote caller sees only sessions whose audience authorizes that caller: audience all_paired, or selected naming that caller's node. Working directories travel only for sessions whose owner opted in. Local owner clients may request the owner-local view.
addressing: Both forms are accepted wherever a session is named: <provider>:<id> means this node, and <node-id>/<provider>:<id> names one. agent_list returns the qualified form. An address the caller may not see — an unpaired node, a session its owner did not authorise for this node, or none at all — gets one indistinguishable answer, "unknown node or session"; a malformed address is reported as malformed.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.title: List available agents
tools.description: List sessions visible to the caller. Private sessions are excluded from remote views.

node.description: Restrict the listing to one node. Omit for every node the caller may see.

tools.name: agent_status
tools.title: Get agent status
tools.description: Return normalized lifecycle and evidence for one visible session.

agentId.description: <provider>:<id> for this node, or <node-id>/<provider>:<id> for a named node.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.title: Send message to agent
tools.description: Queue a message for a visible destination whose owner accepts messages. This does not bypass provider approval or wake-up policy.

agentId.description: <provider>:<id> for this node, or <node-id>/<provider>:<id> for a named node.

tools.name: agent_inbox
tools.title: Read agent inbox
tools.description: Read queued messages addressed to the caller's managed session.

notOffered: Paging (pageSize, cursor) and an idempotency key were in the draft and are not served. agent_list returns the whole visible set with a count and a total; a resend is a second message. Adding either means adding it to the Go argument struct, which is what generates these schemas.
